INSERT INTO account_research_people_discovery_polls (
    organization_id,
    pipeline_run_id,
    poll_job_id,
    robot_id,
    initial_person_chunk_ids
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5
)
ON CONFLICT (organization_id, pipeline_run_id)
DO UPDATE
SET
    poll_job_id = EXCLUDED.poll_job_id,
    robot_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.robot_id, account_research_people_discovery_polls.robot_id),
    initial_person_chunk_ids = EXCLUDED.initial_person_chunk_ids,
    updated_at = now()
RETURNING
    organization_id,
    pipeline_run_id,
    poll_job_id,
    robot_id,
    initial_person_chunk_ids,
    created_at,
    updated_at
